visual.general_description: Four-step flow diagram of how a telemedicine encounter is arranged: contact the office, triage, scheduling, FaceTime encounter.
visual.detailed_description: Flow diagram of four stacked rounded blue boxes with white text, staggered slightly to the right going down, on a grey background, joined by three large pale-blue downward block arrows. Top box prints "Participant contacts the office (Office hours 9AM- 4PM)." Second box prints "Nurse/ MD triages the reasons for the requests for telemedicine visits." Third box prints "Program coordinator arranges an appointment time." Bottom box prints "MD / Nurse telemedicine encounter via FaceTime." Each arrow starts at the lower right edge of one box and points down into the next box. No photograph, patient, face, date, identifier or panel letter is present.

visual.general_description: Three bar charts of group-level health-care utilization: totals over months 1-6, and monthly ER visits and hospitalizations by telemedicine use.
visual.detailed_description: Three stacked bar charts on a white background, lettered A, B and C down the left edge. A is a single blue-series chart of four utilization totals; B and C are grouped bar charts by month with a legend of blue "Yes TM" and red "No TM". See the panel descriptions for titles, axis labels, categories and the bars present in each group.

panels.general_description: Single-series bar chart of group totals for four kinds of health-care use.
panels.detailed_description: Panel A letter A at upper left; white background bar chart titled "Healthcare Utilization Totals (Months 1-6) (n=10)". Y axis label "# Visits" with printed ticks 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60. Four blue bars of one series stand over the category labels "TM Physician Visits", "In-person Physician Visits", "ER Visits" and "Hospitalizations". The In-person Physician Visits bar is the tallest, the TM Physician Visits bar is the second tallest, the ER Visits bar is shorter than that and the Hospitalizations bar is the shortest. No numbers are printed on the bars and no legend is shown.

charts.title: Healthcare Utilization Totals (Months 1-6) (n=10)

X axis categories "1 Month (n=10)", "2 Month (n=10)", "3 Month (n=7)", "4 Month (n=8)", "5 Month (n=7)", "6 Month (n=8)". Legend below: blue square "Yes TM" and red square "No TM". Blue bars appear in the 1 Month and 2 Month groups only; red bars appear in the 1, 2, 3 and 4 Month groups; the 5 Month and 6 Month groups show no bars. In the 1 Month and 2 Month groups the red bar is taller than the blue bar. No numbers are printed on the bars.
